JobDef.reportString: planting a sapling for the Greening.
digging the scraps into the field.
cooking mushroom stew for the feast.
going round the lamps and doors.

li.label: kept the Greening
li.description: A sapling for every tree we took, and a meal together under the old tree. It felt like paying back something we owed.

li.label: kept the Deep Silver
li.description: I carried the silver down and dropped it into the rock, and said the old names over it. It's done for another year.

li.label: kept the Letting Pass
li.description: The herd out on the long grass, and the old story told at dusk. A quiet, good day.

li.label: kept the Turning Under
li.description: The year's scraps went back into the ground, and there was mushroom stew. Nothing goes to waste.

li.label: kept the First Spark
li.description: Something broken mended, every machine looked over, and the lights left on all night. Everything runs a little better for it.

li.label: a silent supper
li.description: We ate the plainest food together and nobody had to say anything. It was restful.

li.label: the Shuttered Night
li.description: Every door shut and every lamp lit, and whatever was out there went past. I slept well behind it.

li.label: watched the longest night
li.description: I kept watch on the walls from dusk till the sun came up. Long and cold, but I'm glad it was me.

plain.li: [hollin,plant] One for every tree we took, that's only fair.
[hollin,plant] There, that one will be taller than me one day.
[hollin,plant] Set them deep and pack the earth down, they'll take.
[hollin,plant,named] {GOD} gave us the wood, so we give her the trees back.
[hollin,plant,scoffer] Planting trees is good work, feast day or not.
[hollin,meal] We eat under the old tree today, that's how the day goes.
[hollin,meal] This tree was here long before any of us.
[hollin,meal,named] {GOD} likes us under her oldest tree on this day.
[smoulder,down] Down it goes, to the one under the mountain.
[smoulder,down] Old one, deep one, coil under the stone, take it and sleep.
[smoulder,down] There, that's the year's silver gone to the deep.
[smoulder,down,named] {GOD}, take the silver and keep sleeping.
[smoulder,down,scoffer] That's good silver going down a hole, but it's the custom.
[smoulder,empty] Nothing to give this year, but I came all the same.
[smoulder,empty,named] No silver this year, {GOD}, only your names.
[bellwether,herd] Go on, the long grass is yours today.
[bellwether,herd] We leave the edge for them today, it's the Letting Pass.
[bellwether,alone] No herd to walk out, so I'll walk out myself.
[bellwether,story] Long ago a white beast walked through this land and left everything living behind it.
[bellwether,story] This is how the white beast came by and the grass grew back where it had walked.
[bellwether,story,children] Sit down, all of you, this is the old story about the white beast.
[bellwether,story,named] This is the story of {GOD}, who walked through and let everything live.
[morel,dig] Back into the ground with it, it'll come back as soil.
[morel,dig] Everything rots in the end, and that's the good part.
[morel,dig,named] {GOD} takes what we throw away and makes it good again.
[morel,dig,scoffer] It's compost, but I'll grant it's good compost.
[morel,stew] Mushroom stew for the Turning Under, as it should be.
[morel,stew] It smells like the cellar, which means it's done right.
[pip,mended] There, it works again, a broken thing mended.
[pip,mended,named] Fixed, and {GOD} would be pleased with that.
[pip,machine] A bit of oil and a look over, that's all they want.
[pip,machine] Listen to it run, that's a happy machine.
[pip,bench] No machines here, but the benches deserve a look too.
[pip,lamp] All the lights on tonight, that's the First Spark.
[pip,lamp] Leave this one burning till morning.
[pip,alllit] Every light is already on, good.
[undertow,shut] Shut the doors, it's the Shuttered Night.
[undertow,shut] Close it up and let whatever's out there pass by.
[undertow,lamp] Every lamp lit tonight, so it goes past us.
[undertow,lamp] Light them all, the dark goes round a lit house.
[undertow,lamp,scoffer] Lamps on and doors shut, it's sensible enough on a dark night.
[undertow,alllit] Doors shut and lamps lit already, good.
[selene,watch] Up on the walls till dawn, it's the longest night.
[selene,watch] We watch tonight, and we tell our dreams in the morning.
[selene,watch,named] {GOD} is up all night, so we stay up with her.
[selene,dream] I dreamt the moon came down to the wall and looked at each of us.
[selene,dream] I dreamt I was walking on the wall and the stars were close enough to touch.
[selene,dream] I dreamt of the sea last night, and I've never even seen the sea.
[selene,dream] I dreamt someone I used to know was calling me from the far side of a river.
[selene,dream] I dreamt the whole colony was silver, every roof of it.
[selene,dream,watched] I nodded off on the wall for a moment and dreamt the moon was talking to me.
[selene,dream,watched] Up on the wall I kept thinking I saw someone walking, and then I dreamt it.
[selene,dream,scoffer] I dreamt about breakfast, and here it is.
